Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/whats-new
Fetched: 2026-05-18

# What's new in Copilot Studio

## April 2026

- Configure hold and resume for voice-enabled agents to pause mid-conversation and resume where you left off.
- (Preview) Build and deploy real-time voice agents for Copilot Studio and Dynamics 365 Contact Center, with support for NLU, multilingual conversations, knowledge integration, security settings, voice tuning settings. Configure and test directly in Copilot Studio, then publish to your telephony channel.
- Trigger agent evaluations automatically using the Copilot Studio connector with Power Automate.
- (Preview) Run automated agent evaluations from a REST API using the Power Platform API to integrate evaluation into CI/CD pipelines.
- Use the agent usage estimator to forecast Copilot credit consumption.
- (Preview) Analyze your agent with custom metrics by defining your own analytics categories.
- (General availability) Connect agents to other agents using the agent-to-agent (A2A) protocol.
- (Preview) Add a display name suffix to identify agents across environments in Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot using environment variables.
- (Preview) Use GPT-5.5 Reasoning (Deep) as an experimental model for agents requiring deep analytical reasoning.
- Share analytics access with colleagues using the new Analytics Viewer role.

## March 2026

- (Preview) Use Work IQ tools to connect Microsoft 365 Copilot and your agents to the Work IQ service for real-time work insights from Microsoft 365 files, emails, meetings, chats.
- View and filter detailed lists of user questions and reactions from your agent's conversations.
- For users with Bot transcript viewer privileges, downloaded session transcripts now include session-level customer satisfaction (CSAT) values.
- For users with Bot transcript viewer privileges, download filtered questions or reactions to a .csv file.
- Use the Prompt assistant in Prompt builder to draft prompts faster with GPT model–powered suggestions.
- Add Bing Custom Search as a knowledge source.
- Configure post-call action topics for voice-enabled agents.
- Configure reprompt messages in Question nodes with randomization support.
- Apply accessibility best practices for Adaptive Cards.
- Agent evaluations are now generally available (GA).
- Create multi-turn conversation tests in Copilot Studio.
- ChatGPT-5 generally available globally (excluding GCC environments) for use in production agents.
- Claude Sonnet 4.5, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and Claude Opus generally available globally (excluding GCC).
- Use an agent node to call a Copilot Studio agent from an agent flow.

## February 2026

- Improved agent responses for ticket-based Microsoft 365 Graph connectors (ServiceNow tickets, Azure DevOps work items).
- Select Claude Sonnet 4.5 (beta) for Computer Use agents.
- Prompt builder enhancements:
    - Configure content moderation sensitivity per prompt.
    - Optimize prompts with new Claude models (Claude Opus 4.6 or Claude Sonnet 4.5).
    - Edit prompt instructions and settings inline in agent tool details.

## January 2026

- (Preview) Agent evaluation enhancements: real-time thumbs-up/down feedback, activity maps, validated CSV template for test sets.
- (Preview) Expand computer use capabilities with new model support, built-in credentials, enhanced audit logging with session replay, and Cloud PC pooling.
- (General availability) Microsoft Copilot Studio extension for Microsoft Visual Studio Code.

## December 2025

- Compare multiple agent versions side by side when evaluating agents with test sets.

## November 2025

- GPT-5 Chat rolls out to Copilot Studio in general availability for European and United States regions (November 24, 2025).
- (Preview) Automatically create Microsoft Entra agent identities for agents.
- Improved knowledge retrieval for SharePoint-grounded agents using Work IQ.
- Improve response accuracy with SharePoint metadata filters.
- Orchestrate multiple agents to break down complex tasks; link agents to Microsoft Fabric data agents.
- (Preview) Add tool groups to agents for faster setup (Outlook, SharePoint connector tool groups).
- Copy agents from Microsoft 365 Copilot to Copilot Studio.
- (Preview) Add human input to agent workflows with the request information action via Outlook.
- Update Power Platform API calls to use the new 'copilotstudio' namespace.
- Use component collections with new enhancements (sidebar access, support for primary agents, child agents, MCP connector types).

## October 2025

- GPT-4o retired (Oct 27-31 except GCC); GPT-4.1 becomes default model.
- Choose from multiple AI models.
- (Preview) Test and deploy GPT-5 models.
- Copilot Studio Kit suite of tools (Power CAT).
- (Preview) Group related user questions into themes.
- Track time and cost savings for autonomous and conversational agents.
- Access unified activity and transcript view, pin sessions, submit feedback.
- (Preview) Accelerate flow execution (express mode).
- Use the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.
- (Preview) Evaluate your agents using customizable test sets.

## September 2025

- (Preview) Automate tasks in desktop applications on Windows using Computer-Using Agents (CUA).
- Embed Copilot agents into Android, iOS, and Windows apps using the Client SDK.
- (Preview) Upload Excel, CSV, PDF files for agent analysis using Python code (code interpreter in chat).

## August 2025

- (GA) Code interpreter to generate Python code-based actions from natural language.
- (GA) File groups for knowledge sources.
- Allow users to upload files and images.
- (GA) Generated answer rate and quality analytics.
- Connect to an existing MCP server directly within Copilot Studio.

## July 2025

- Advanced NLU customization.
- Search across your agent's knowledge, topics, tools, skills, entities.
- ROI analytics for agents with autonomous capabilities.
- View user comments with thumbs up/down reactions.
- (Preview) Display Microsoft Information Protection (MIP) labels.
- Publish agents to WhatsApp phone number.
- (Preview) SSO Consent Card for Microsoft Entra ID-backed actions.

## June 2025

- Improved tools experience: grouping/filtering, IntelliSense, calendar/file picker/timezone widgets, automatic SSO detection.
- (Preview) Microsoft 365 Copilot Tuning to train models on enterprise data.
- Actionable insights for unanswered questions grouped by themes.
- Knowledge sources analysis for autonomous agents.
- Power Fx formulas in embedded prompt builder.
- Regular expression support for Power Fx formulas (IsMatch, Match, MatchAll).
- (Preview) File groups as knowledge sources.
- (Preview) Generative orchestration for all supported languages.
- Redesigned Channels page.
- (US-only preview) GPT-4.1 mini experimental response model.

Updated: 2026-05-18
